name: Blood Feud
description: This opponent won't let it go. The beef is personal now.

chapters.title: The Call Out
chapters.description: Your last opponent dropped a track calling you out. They're all over social media saying you're ducking them.

choices.label: Respond Publicly
choices.description: Fire back on social media. Let them know you're not scared.

choices.label: Ignore It
choices.description: You're focused on bigger things. Let them talk.

choices.label: Accept the Rematch
choices.description: You've got no reason to duck. Set it up.

chapters.title: Social Media War
chapters.description: It's back and forth daily. Fans are picking sides. This is taking up mental space you need for prep.

choices.label: Keep It Going
choices.description: You're winning this war. Don't stop now.

choices.label: Settle It in the Ring
choices.description: Challenge them to stop talking and battle.

chapters.title: They Won't Stop
chapters.description: You ignored them but they kept going. Now they're making up lies about you. People are starting to believe it.

choices.label: Address the Lies
choices.description: You have to say something now.

choices.label: Threaten Legal Action
choices.description: This is defamation. Get a lawyer involved.

chapters.title: Viral Moment
chapters.description: The beef is everywhere. Every battle rap media outlet is covering it. The whole culture is watching.

choices.label: Milk the Attention
choices.description: This is good for business. Keep it going.

choices.label: End It Now
choices.description: Book the battle before this goes too far.

chapters.title: Rematch Booked
chapters.description: It's official. You're battling them again. The stakes are higher than ever. Everyone's watching.

choices.label: Prepare Like Your Life Depends On It
choices.description: Every waking moment goes into this battle.

choices.label: Stay Balanced
choices.description: Prepare well but don't let it consume you.

chapters.title: Main Event
chapters.description: A major league is offering to host the battle as their main event. Big money. Huge exposure. Everything on the line.

choices.label: Take the Main Event
choices.description: This is what you've been building toward.

choices.label: Do It Smaller
choices.description: Less pressure. Keep it about the battle, not the spectacle.

endings.title: Lawyered Up
endings.description: You went legal. Some people respect it, most think you're soft for not handling it in battle.

endings.title: Redemption Arc
endings.description: You came back and bodied them. The culture loves a redemption story. Your name is ringing now.

endings.title: Debatable
endings.description: The rematch was close. No clear winner. The beef might continue or both of you might move on.

endings.title: Main Event Energy
endings.description: The biggest battle of your career. Win or lose, everyone knows your name now.
